overall_summary: Analysis of the recent 16 videos shows that 'self respect' is clearly outperforming other topics, capturing the highest view counts consistently (ranging between 22 to 40 views, notably video AfaLxMy6FMY at 40 and rwOUYo_hayQ at 39). In contrast, generic late-night or overthinking themes with abstract hooks (like WhJ-VwRa3Rg or uIbMpCjVutQ) are underperforming. The audience strongly connects with micro-actions related to digital boundaries and self-worth.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on deleting chats, blocking, muting, or hiding status (e.g., AfaLxMy6FMY, rwOUYo_hayQ, 0H4VygZ3DIU) consistently average higher views (30-40) compared to abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks and stories around concrete smartphone actions that symbolize emotional detachment and self-respect.

winning_patterns.evidence: Hooks starting with precise physical or screen interactions (e.g., 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी', 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर') hook the viewer immediately.
winning_patterns.action: Open scripts with an active, tactile moment involving the phone screen or contact list.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (hook: 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') received only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic atmospheric intros about tea, cold nights, or general longing without a sharp behavioral trigger.
